name: PineNote Wave
description: Replaces the e-ink full-screen flash with a band that sweeps across the screen. Clearing ghosting only needs every pixel driven through one black-white swing; doing that as a moving front instead of all at once is the whole difference between a flash and a wave. Lives in the shell because a GTK window cannot be made transparent here - an undecorated GTK4 window carries .solid-csd, which paints an opaque background that no CSS override could remove, so the sweep was an invisible black band on a black sheet. A shell actor composites over the desktop with no window involved. Driven over D-Bus so the parameters can be tuned without restarting the session.
